media_work.title: The Suspect
media_work.focus_or_theme: The case of Hassan Diab, a Canadian citizen extradited to France for a 1980 bombing he maintains he did not commit; issues with extradition law; anti-terrorism prosecutions; potential wrongful accusation/conviction.
media_work.summaryNotes: Diab spent over 3 years in French prison without charge before being released in 2018 due to lack of evidence, only to be convicted in absentia in 2023 based on allegedly flawed evidence.

media_item.focus_or_theme: The case of Hassan Diab, a Canadian citizen extradited to France for a 1980 bombing he maintains he did not commit; issues with extradition law; anti-terrorism prosecutions; potential wrongful accusation/conviction.
media_item.summary_notes: The documentary focuses on Hassan Diab, a Canadian citizen extradited to France for a 1980 bombing he maintains he did not commit. He spent over 3 years in French prison before being released due to lack of evidence, only to be convicted in absentia in 2023 based on allegedly flawed evidence. The film explores issues with extradition law and anti-terrorism prosecutions.

featured_individuals.narrative_summary: Dr. Hassan Diab was convicted in absentia in France in 2023 for the 1980 Rue Copernic synagogue bombing after spending over 3 years in pre-trial detention and being released due to lack of evidence. His extradition from Canada and subsequent conviction are controversial. Advocacy groups urge Canada to refuse any second extradition request.

In absentia trial lacking due process
